cards.name: Emberling
cards.subtitle: Ember Beast
cards.flavor: Born of a spark, it never learned how to be cold.

cards.name: Ash Phoenix
cards.subtitle: Ember Beast
cards.flavor: It does not die: it waits until there is enough ash.

cards.name: Ember Fox
cards.subtitle: Ember Beast
cards.flavor: Its tail singes the ferns and rekindles dead hearths.

cards.name: Bakehouse Drakeling
cards.subtitle: Ember Beast
cards.flavor: It sleeps on warm bread and snores cinders.

cards.name: Slate Salamander
cards.subtitle: Ember Beast
cards.flavor: Wherever it passes, the stone keeps its warmth a moment longer.

cards.name: Forge Owl
cards.subtitle: Ember Beast
cards.flavor: It counts the hammer blows and is never wrong.

cards.name: Lava Stag
cards.subtitle: Ember Beast
cards.flavor: Its antlers steam at the first snow.

cards.name: Coal Raven
cards.subtitle: Ember Beast
cards.flavor: It brings the smiths the news of the wind.

cards.name: Basalt Warden
cards.subtitle: Ember Beast
cards.flavor: Still for a thousand winters, it holds the warmth of the first.

cards.name: Soot Wolf
cards.subtitle: Ember Beast
cards.flavor: You only see it by the glow it steals from campfires.

cards.name: Mother Forge
cards.subtitle: Land of Fire
cards.flavor: This is where the world learned to be warm.

cards.name: The Silent Crater
cards.subtitle: Land of Fire
cards.flavor: Something beats down there, far beneath the rock.

cards.name: Valley of Cinders
cards.subtitle: Land of Fire
cards.flavor: A grey river runs through it, lukewarm, toward a sea it will never see.

cards.name: Slag Bridge
cards.subtitle: Land of Fire
cards.flavor: It stands out of habit, and out of the respect it is shown.

cards.name: Firewatch Tower
cards.subtitle: Land of Fire
cards.flavor: Its lantern has not dimmed in three generations.

cards.name: Coal Gallery
cards.subtitle: Land of Fire
cards.flavor: Every step wakes a small red constellation.

cards.name: Scalding Spring
cards.subtitle: Land of Fire
cards.flavor: Travellers boil their tea and their grudges here.

cards.name: Spark Plateau
cards.subtitle: Land of Fire
cards.flavor: The wind carries more light than dust up here.

cards.name: Forgotten Foundry
cards.subtitle: Land of Fire
cards.flavor: The chimneys still smoke, and nobody knows why.

cards.name: Sulphur Pass
cards.subtitle: Land of Fire
cards.flavor: Cross it quickly, holding your breath and your questions.

cards.name: Dawn Hammer
cards.subtitle: Forge Work
cards.flavor: Every blow it strikes lifts a little more daylight.

cards.name: Ember Lantern
cards.subtitle: Forge Work
cards.flavor: Its flame consumes nothing, except fear.

cards.name: Starfallen Anvil
cards.subtitle: Forge Work
cards.flavor: It fell from the sky, and it sings when touched.

cards.name: Quickash Blade
cards.subtitle: Forge Work
cards.flavor: Forged in one night, honed by a thousand mornings.

cards.name: Coal Crown
cards.subtitle: Forge Work
cards.flavor: Light as a memory, warm as a promise.

cards.name: Crater Key
cards.subtitle: Forge Work
cards.flavor: It opens nothing: it reminds the door that it exists.

cards.name: Vial of Sparks
cards.subtitle: Forge Work
cards.flavor: Do not shake it on a festival night.

cards.name: Smiths' Shield
cards.subtitle: Forge Work
cards.flavor: It bears the print of every hand that ever beat it.

cards.name: Bronze Bell
cards.subtitle: Forge Work
cards.flavor: A single note, heard across the whole valley.

cards.name: Soot Talisman
cards.subtitle: Forge Work
cards.flavor: It blackens your fingers and clears your head.

cards.name: Furnace Breath
cards.subtitle: Fire Craft
cards.flavor: One breath in, and winter takes a step back.

cards.name: Shower of Sparks
cards.subtitle: Fire Craft
cards.flavor: It wets no one and lights everyone.

cards.name: Wall of Embers
cards.subtitle: Fire Craft
cards.flavor: No one crosses it, except those with nothing to hide.

cards.name: Rune of the Red Dawn
cards.subtitle: Fire Craft
cards.flavor: Drawn backwards, it brings on the evening.

cards.name: Ash Cloud
cards.subtitle: Fire Craft
cards.flavor: The sky clouds over, then remembers it is blue.

cards.name: Volcano Awakening
cards.subtitle: Fire Craft
cards.flavor: The mountain stretches and the whole country wakes up.

cards.name: Smith's Song
cards.subtitle: Fire Craft
cards.flavor: Three low notes, one spark, and the metal agrees.

cards.name: Slag Bolt
cards.subtitle: Fire Craft
cards.flavor: Short, red, and devilishly convincing.

cards.name: Flame Pact
cards.subtitle: Fire Craft
cards.flavor: You do not sign it: you simply step closer.

cards.name: Ashes Restored
cards.subtitle: Fire Craft
cards.flavor: Under the ash, the seed never stopped listening.

cards.name: Maelis the Smith
cards.subtitle: Forge Companion
cards.flavor: She says a good tool is known by its silence.

cards.name: Oren the Watcher
cards.subtitle: Forge Companion
cards.flavor: He knows which fire is rising, which one sleeps, and which one lies.

cards.name: Tessa Ashmoon
cards.subtitle: Forge Companion
cards.flavor: She reads the future in sparks and the present in people's eyes.

cards.name: Brann the Elder
cards.subtitle: Forge Companion
cards.flavor: He has seen three volcanoes go out and four friendships rekindle.

cards.name: Yssa of the Embers
cards.subtitle: Forge Companion
cards.flavor: She laughs so loud the hearths light up again.

cards.name: Gaspar Slag
cards.subtitle: Forge Companion
cards.flavor: Bad temper, excellent founder.

cards.name: Lioren Flamebearer
cards.subtitle: Forge Companion
cards.flavor: He runs ahead of the storm so the others can walk in shelter.

cards.name: Nael the Founder
cards.subtitle: Forge Companion
cards.flavor: His patience is the one thing he has never melted down.

cards.name: Lady Dawnbright
cards.subtitle: Forge Companion
cards.flavor: She plants seeds in the ash, on principle.

cards.name: Pip the Lamplighter
cards.subtitle: Forge Companion
cards.flavor: The smallest of us carries the brightest light.

cards.name: Ember Night
cards.subtitle: Fire Awakening
cards.flavor: The sky is black, but the earth glows red in reply.

cards.name: Lava Tide
cards.subtitle: Fire Awakening
cards.flavor: Slow, patient, inevitable: it has all the time in the world.

cards.name: Red Dawn
cards.subtitle: Fire Awakening
cards.flavor: They say it brings luck to those already walking.

cards.name: Ash Rain
cards.subtitle: Fire Awakening
cards.flavor: Soft as snow, grey as a regret.

cards.name: Furnace Storm
cards.subtitle: Fire Awakening
cards.flavor: It passes, and the land smells of toast for a week.

cards.name: Burning Eclipse
cards.subtitle: Fire Awakening
cards.flavor: The sun hides, and the mountain takes the chance to shine.

cards.name: Sulphur Mist
cards.subtitle: Fire Awakening
cards.flavor: It stings the eyes and wakes old memories.

cards.name: Fireside Vigil
cards.subtitle: Fire Awakening
cards.flavor: Everyone falls quiet, and we hear each other better than ever.

cards.name: The Great Thaw
cards.subtitle: Fire Awakening
cards.flavor: Everything that was frozen starts moving again.

cards.name: Silence of the Embers
cards.subtitle: Fire Awakening
cards.flavor: When nothing crackles any more, you find that everything still burns.

cards.name: Highland Eagle
cards.subtitle: Highland Beast
cards.flavor: It never looks down, except to find you.

cards.name: Silver Chamois
cards.subtitle: Highland Beast
cards.flavor: It leaps from stone to stone without disturbing any of them.

cards.name: Snow Lynx
cards.subtitle: Highland Beast
cards.flavor: Its tracks vanish before anyone can count them.

cards.name: Moon Owl
cards.subtitle: Highland Beast
cards.flavor: It only sleeps when the moon is full, to keep an eye on it.

cards.name: Frost Giant
cards.subtitle: Highland Beast
cards.flavor: Gentle as a frozen lake, as long as you do not walk on it.

cards.name: Aurora Stag
cards.subtitle: Highland Beast
cards.flavor: Its antlers gather the first light of day.

cards.name: Crystal Falcon
cards.subtitle: Highland Beast
cards.flavor: Its wings chime like ice cracking in the sun.

cards.name: Polar Fox
cards.subtitle: Highland Beast
cards.flavor: White on white, it shows itself only to those who deserve it.

cards.name: Ridge Owl
cards.subtitle: Highland Beast
cards.flavor: It knows the name of every stone, and keeps it to itself.

cards.name: Mist Wolf
cards.subtitle: Highland Beast
cards.flavor: It guides the lost, and bites those who claim to know the way.

cards.name: Lonely Peak
cards.subtitle: High Country
cards.flavor: It never wanted neighbours, just a fine sky.

cards.name: Pass of Winds
cards.subtitle: High Country
cards.flavor: Up here every wind sings its own refrain.

cards.name: Mirror Lake
cards.subtitle: High Country
cards.flavor: It shows the sky, the mountain, and sometimes the face you will have tomorrow.

cards.name: Sky Observatory
cards.subtitle: High Country
cards.flavor: Ten thousand nights of watching, and the sky still keeps its secrets.

cards.name: Frost Stair
cards.subtitle: High Country
cards.flavor: A thousand steps, each with its own small story.

cards.name: Hanging Valley
cards.subtitle: High Country
cards.flavor: A valley within the valley, visited only by the wind.

cards.name: Star Sanctuary
cards.subtitle: High Country
cards.flavor: The sky is so close here you could almost touch it.

cards.name: Singing Glacier
cards.subtitle: High Country
cards.flavor: It cracks, it sings, it remembers every winter.

cards.name: Eagle Ridge
cards.subtitle: High Country
cards.flavor: A narrow edge and a vast horizon: a lesson in humility.

cards.name: Last Fire Hut
cards.subtitle: High Country
cards.flavor: A light in the night, and the promise of a dry bundle of wood.

cards.name: Star Compass
cards.subtitle: Summit Treasure
cards.flavor: It does not point north: it points to what you are missing.

cards.name: Fog Horn
cards.subtitle: Summit Treasure
cards.flavor: Its call cuts through fog and bad moods alike.

cards.name: Aurora Crystal
cards.subtitle: Summit Treasure
cards.flavor: Deep in its ice it keeps a morning that never ends.

cards.name: Silver Ice Axe
cards.subtitle: Summit Treasure
cards.flavor: Neither too heavy nor too light: made to the measure of the climb.

cards.name: Polar Lantern
cards.subtitle: Summit Treasure
cards.flavor: Its blue glow lights what you did not dare to look at.

cards.name: Frost Cloak
cards.subtitle: Summit Treasure
cards.flavor: It does not keep you warm: it makes the cold bearable.

cards.name: Sky Chart
cards.subtitle: Summit Treasure
cards.flavor: Every star is in its place, except one, which is waiting.

cards.name: Winter Ring
cards.subtitle: Summit Treasure
cards.flavor: A circle of frost slowly closing around the seconds.

cards.name: Ice Bell
cards.subtitle: Summit Treasure
cards.flavor: It rings when the weather is about to turn, never before.

cards.name: Lookout's Spyglass
cards.subtitle: Summit Treasure
cards.flavor: You can see far with it, sometimes a little farther than planned.

cards.name: Snowstorm
cards.subtitle: Sky Craft
cards.flavor: White, thick, loud: perfect for hearing nothing at all.

cards.name: Wind Step
cards.subtitle: Sky Craft
cards.flavor: One step, and you are already on the far side of the pass.

cards.name: Aurora Veil
cards.subtitle: Sky Craft
cards.flavor: Stretched over the camp, it keeps dreams warm.

cards.name: Song of the Stars
cards.subtitle: Sky Craft
cards.flavor: Seven low notes, and the sky answers softly.

cards.name: Flash Freeze
cards.subtitle: Sky Craft
cards.flavor: Time stops, for the blink of an eye.

cards.name: Eagle's Call
cards.subtitle: Sky Craft
cards.flavor: One feather thrown to the wind, and the sky falls into order.

cards.name: Summit Breath
cards.subtitle: Sky Craft
cards.flavor: It fills the lungs and empties the head.

cards.name: Moon Path
cards.subtitle: Sky Craft
cards.flavor: A silver path on the water that ends exactly where it should.

cards.name: Frost Rune
cards.subtitle: Sky Craft
cards.flavor: It freezes the moment, and makes it beautiful.

cards.name: Starfall
cards.subtitle: Sky Craft
cards.flavor: Make a wish, but choose it quickly.

cards.name: Aldric the Guide
cards.subtitle: Rope Companion
cards.flavor: He knows the mountain the way you know a stubborn old friend.

cards.name: Nuala of the Snows
cards.subtitle: Rope Companion
cards.flavor: She walks on snow without leaving a print.

cards.name: Orsino Farsight
cards.subtitle: Rope Companion
cards.flavor: He sees everything, and never says more than he must.

cards.name: Selene the Mapmaker
cards.subtitle: Rope Companion
cards.flavor: She draws the world by following her own footsteps.

cards.name: Tobias Iceaxe
cards.subtitle: Rope Companion
cards.flavor: A smile, a rope, and the certainty of getting back down.

cards.name: Ilya the Scout
cards.subtitle: Rope Companion
cards.flavor: She leaves before dawn and comes back with the day.

cards.name: Master Corvin
cards.subtitle: Rope Companion
cards.flavor: He talks to the ravens, who listen out of politeness.

cards.name: Anouk of the Ridges
cards.subtitle: Rope Companion
cards.flavor: She sings to the goats, who sing to the summits.

cards.name: Fenn the Porter
cards.subtitle: Rope Companion
cards.flavor: He carries everything, including the team's spirits.

cards.name: Vesper the Keeper
cards.subtitle: Rope Companion
cards.flavor: She keeps the fire and the stories, in that order.

cards.name: Moonless Night
cards.subtitle: Summit Sky
cards.flavor: There have never been so many stars.

cards.name: Northern Lights
cards.subtitle: Summit Sky
cards.flavor: The sky unrolls its ribbons and the silence applauds.

cards.name: Meteor Shower
cards.subtitle: Summit Sky
cards.flavor: Everyone looks up, and everyone makes the same wish.

cards.name: Sea of Clouds
cards.subtitle: Summit Sky
cards.flavor: Above, it is paradise; below, it is Monday.

cards.name: The Great Cold
cards.subtitle: Summit Sky
cards.flavor: Even words freeze before they reach the ear.

cards.name: Silent Eclipse
cards.subtitle: Summit Sky
cards.flavor: For a moment, the mountain holds its breath.

cards.name: Silver Snow
cards.subtitle: Summit Sky
cards.flavor: It falls without a sound, like an idea arriving.

cards.name: Solstice
cards.subtitle: Summit Sky
cards.flavor: The longest night or the longest day: that is up to you.

cards.name: Conjunction
cards.subtitle: Summit Sky
cards.flavor: Three stars in a line, and the world holds its breath.

cards.name: Peakrise
cards.subtitle: Summit Sky
cards.flavor: The mountain finally clears the shadow and begins to shine.
